problem.title: Linked List in Binary Tree
problem.problemStatement: Given the head of a singly linked list and the root of a binary tree, determine whether the linked list exists as a downward path in the binary tree. A downward path starts at any node and proceeds only through child pointers. Return true if such a path exists; otherwise return false.
problem.output: true if the linked list appears as a downward path, otherwise false.
problem.constraints: Number of linked list nodes is in the range [1, 100] Number of tree nodes is in the range [1, 2500] -100 <= node.value <= 100
